chatgpt.p: Look at my latest unread emails. Summarize the three most important emails that require my attention today. For each one, explain what it is about and draft a polite, brief response that I can review and send.

gemini.p: @Gmail Check my inbox from the last 24 hours. List the top three urgent emails I need to respond to, summarize what each sender wants, and write a polite, concise draft reply for each one.

claude.p: Review my connected Gmail inbox. Group my unread messages into important versus low priority. For the important ones, write a brief summary and draft a warm, clear response for me to send.

2.note: This helps you read the document. It does not replace advice. Check the important terms yourself, or with a professional, before you sign or rely on it.

chatgpt.how: Tap + next to the message box. Add the PDF, or take a photo of the paper contract.
chatgpt.p: Read this attached document. Explain the three most important points I need to know in plain, simple English. Highlight any hidden fees, deadlines, or cancellation clauses I should be aware of before I sign or reply.

gemini.how: Tap + in the message bar. Add the file, or take a clear photo of the page.
gemini.p: Look at this attached file. Act as a plain-English document assistant and summarize the three key points. Flag any deadlines, extra charges, or unexpected terms in simple bullet points.

claude.how: Tap + in the chat box. Add the file or a photo of the agreement.
claude.p: Using the document I uploaded, explain the most important clauses in plain language. List any risks, hidden fees, or important deadlines in three simple bullet points.

chatgpt.p: Look at this list of filenames from my computer desktop. Group them into four clean categories: Financial Records, Home Projects, Personal Documents, and Archive. Give me a simple folder structure so I can reorganize my computer in ten minutes.

gemini.p: @Google Drive Look at the files in my 'Desktop Cleanup' folder. Organize them into four clear categories: Financials, Household, Family Records, and Archive. Provide a clear step-by-step checklist to organize them.

claude.p: I have connected my drive files. Group them into clear, logical folders and show me an organized directory layout that is easy to maintain.

4.note: Not every problem has a quick fix. Start with safe steps like restarting. If a fix means opening a device or touching wiring, call a professional.

chatgpt.how: Take a photo of the screen showing the error. Tap + and attach it.
chatgpt.p: Look at this photo of my screen error. Explain what went wrong in plain language and give me three simple, step-by-step instructions to fix it without calling technical support.

gemini.how: Tap + in the message bar and add a photo of the error screen.
gemini.p: Examine this photo of my error screen. Tell me what is happening in non-technical terms and give me a clear list of what button to press next.

claude.how: Tap + in the chat box and attach the photo of the error.
claude.p: I have uploaded a photo of a technical error on my device. Explain the issue simply and give me a step-by-step fix in plain language.

chatgpt.p: Act as my real estate researcher. Search the web and compare [Insert Address 1] and [Insert Address 2] in Florence. Compare quietness, proximity to food markets, ease of walking, and overall neighborhood feel.

gemini.p: @Google Maps Compare [Insert Neighborhood 1] and [Insert Neighborhood 2] in Florence. Tell me which area is quieter, more walkable, and closer to fresh markets, along with key pros and cons of each.

claude.p: Act as my location consultant. I am comparing two areas for a relaxed stay: [Insert Neighborhood 1] and [Insert Neighborhood 2]. Compare them based on atmosphere, convenience, quietness, and walkability.

chatgpt.p: Act as my patient advocate and medical translator. Look at this attached lab report or doctor summary. Translate the technical medical terms and numbers into plain, simple English. Tell me which markers are normal, which ones need attention, and give me a short list of clear questions I should ask my physician at my next visit.

gemini.p: Examine this attached medical report. Explain the findings in simple, non-technical language. Break down what the test results mean and provide three specific, practical questions I can take with me to my doctor.

claude.p: Using the attached medical document, translate the clinical findings into plain language. Explain what the primary test values indicate and list the key points I should discuss with my healthcare provider.

chatgpt.p: Act as my billing advocate. Look at this attached medical bill or insurance statement. Break down what these charges mean in plain English, check for any unusual or duplicate fees, and write a polite, firm dispute email or appeal letter that I can send to my insurance provider or billing office.

gemini.p: Examine this attached medical invoice. Translate the complex line items into simple terms, verify if the explanation of benefits matches, and write a concise, professional letter asking the billing department to clarify these specific charges.

claude.p: Using the attached billing document, explain what I am being billed for in simple bullet points. Identify any questionable fees, and draft a clear follow-up letter to challenge the charges and request an itemized review.

chatgpt.p: Act as my consumer rights advocate. I need to write a firm, formal complaint letter to [Insert Company Name] demanding a full refund of [Insert Amount] for [Insert Issue, e.g., a canceled flight / defective product / poor service]. Write a professional email that states our consumer rights, sets a clear 5-day deadline for response, and mentions that I am prepared to escalate the dispute to consumer protection authorities or my credit card company.

gemini.p: Help me draft a strong, professional refund request email to [Insert Company Name]. Outline the timeline of what happened regarding [Insert Issue], state clearly why their service failed to meet the purchase agreement, and request an immediate refund within 48 hours.

claude.p: Using the attached customer service chat logs and receipt, write an authoritative, polished escalation email to upper management. Demand a prompt refund for [Insert Issue], maintain a calm but unyielding tone, and outline the next steps if they fail to resolve this.

chatgpt.p: Act as my air passenger rights expert. My flight from [City A] to [City B] on [Airline Name] was delayed by [Number] hours / canceled, causing me to miss my connection and lose a day of my trip. Look up current airline compensation rules for this route, and write a formal demand letter to the airline citing the exact regulations, requesting our entitled cash compensation, and asking for reimbursement for our meal and transport expenses.

gemini.p: @Google Search Act as my travel claims specialist. Write a formal compensation claim email to [Airline Name] regarding flight [Flight Number] on [Date]. Detail the delay, cite passenger protection laws, and demand a full refund plus statutory compensation for the disruption.

claude.p: Using my attached flight tickets and delay notices, write a strict, professional compensation demand letter to [Airline Name]. Outline our legal rights under applicable aviation regulations, attach our receipt totals for out-of-pocket expenses, and set a 10-day deadline for payment.

chatgpt.p: Act as my construction and home repair project manager. Look at this attached quote from a contractor for [mention project, e.g., bathroom plumbing repair / wall repainting]. Break down the costs into Labor, Materials, and Profit/Markup. Tell me if these prices are fair for standard market rates, identify any missing line items or hidden traps (like waste removal fees), and give me three smart questions to ask the contractor before I sign.

gemini.p: Examine this attached contractor estimate. Analyze whether the material and labor costs are reasonable, highlight any vague language or potential hidden extra charges, and write a polite counter-proposal text message asking for a fixed-price cap and a clear warranty on the work.

claude.p: Using the attached repair quote, analyze the scope of work. Break down the estimate into clear bullet points, flag any financial risks or ambiguous terms (such as 'materials billed at cost plus time'), and draft a professional email requesting a detailed, itemized breakdown before work begins.

chatgpt.p: Act as my expert travel deal scout. I am looking for discounted flights / train tickets from [Departure City] to [Destination City] for dates around [Date Range]. Search the web for the best current rates, recommend specific booking platforms or alternative nearby airports, and give me three insider tips on the best days of the week to book this specific route to save the most money.

gemini.p: @Google Flights Act as my personal ticket booking assistant. Help me find the most cost-effective travel options from [Departure City] to [Destination City] for [Dates]. Compare direct flights with smart layover options, check historical price trends for this season, and suggest the cheapest dates to fly.

claude.p: Using my travel criteria (destination: [City], dates: [Dates], budget preferences: [Budget]), act as my travel strategy advisor. Outline a step-by-step booking plan, recommend reliable discount aggregators, and tell me how to set up price alerts so I lock in the lowest possible fare.

chatgpt.p: Act as my personal financial auditor. Look at this attached statement snippet. Identify every recurring subscription, membership, or monthly fee. Categorize them from most essential to least essential, calculate the annual total they are costing me, and write a polite cancellation email or cancellation script for the ones I want to drop.

gemini.p: Examine this attached statement. Highlight all recurring monthly charges, estimate how much money they add up to over 12 months, and give me a step-by-step checklist to cancel the unused services quickly.

claude.p: Using the attached financial records, audit my recurring monthly expenses. List every subscription in a clean table with its monthly and yearly cost, and draft a formal cancellation message for services that charge hidden termination fees.

chatgpt.p: Act as my consumer rights advocate. I bought a [Product Name] on [Date] for [Price], and it has stopped working / broken under normal use. Look at this attached receipt or photo. Write a firm, professional warranty claim email to the manufacturer customer support department, citing standard consumer protection or manufacturer warranty terms, and demand a free repair, replacement, or full refund.

gemini.p: Help me write a strong warranty claim to [Company Name]. I purchased [Product] which malfunctioned after a few months. Outline the purchase timeline, attach details from my receipt photo, and request an immediate replacement unit under their warranty policy.

claude.p: Using the attached purchase receipt and product details, write an unyielding, professional warranty dispute letter. State clearly why the product failed to meet basic quality expectations, outline our statutory warranty rights, and demand a prompt replacement or refund.

chatgpt.how: Open your fridge and pantry. Take a photo and attach it with +.
chatgpt.p: Look at this photo of my fridge and pantry. Act as my private executive chef and build a complete, balanced 7-day dinner menu using mostly these ingredients. Include a short extra shopping list for only the basic fresh items I need to buy to complete the week.

gemini.how: Tap + in the message bar and add a photo of your fridge.
gemini.p: Examine the ingredients in this photo. Create a structured 7-day meal plan for dinner. Keep prep times under 30 minutes per night and list any small pantry gaps I need to purchase.

claude.how: Tap + in the chat box and add a photo of your kitchen ingredients.
claude.p: I have uploaded a photo of my current kitchen ingredients. Act as my nutritionist and chef to design a simple, delicious 7-day dinner menu. Provide a clear grocery checklist for any missing essentials.

chatgpt.p: Act as an event designer. Help me write the text and design concept for an invitation card for an intimate 50th birthday dinner. The theme is modern Mediterranean elegance. Give me three options for formal yet warm invitation wording, plus detailed visual layout suggestions.

gemini.p: Design a chic, elegant invitation card layout for a weekend dinner party. Provide the exact invitation wording, suggested color scheme, typography style, and decorative details.

claude.p: Using my connected Canva tool, help me create an invitation design concept for a sunset cocktail gathering. Provide the exact formal wording, color palette, and layout recommendations.

chatgpt.p: Act as my personal travel agent. I am planning a 5-day trip to Florence in October. I prefer a relaxed pace, quiet cafes, excellent local dining, and minimal walking up steep hills. Create a daily itinerary with morning and afternoon activities, plus two restaurant suggestions near the town center for each day.

gemini.p: @Google Maps Act as my personal travel companion. Build a relaxed 5-day schedule for Florence focused on quiet dining, art galleries, and minimal walking up steep hills. Include two restaurant suggestions per day.

claude.p: Act as my travel strategist. Design a stress-free 5-day itinerary for Florence for someone who values comfort, quiet mornings, fantastic food, and minimal steep walking. Include rest breaks and dining highlights.

chatgpt.p: Act as my personal fashion stylist. Look at this photo of my jacket. I am attending an evening outdoor event with a smart elegant dress code. Suggest three complete outfit concepts built around this jacket, including recommendations for trousers, footwear suitable for grass, and accessories.

gemini.p: Look at this photo of my jacket. Suggest three chic outfit combinations for a smart elegant evening event. Include advice on footwear suitable for outdoor grass and complementary colors.

claude.p: Act as my wardrobe consultant. Using the photo of this clothing item, create three distinct outfit ideas suitable for a high-end, relaxed social gathering.

chatgpt.p: Act as my interior designer. Look at this photo of my living room. I want to make the space feel warmer, more elegant, and less cluttered without buying an entirely new sofa. Suggest three specific layout or decor adjustments, including color palettes for lighting, cushions, and wall art.

gemini.p: Look at this photo of my living space. Suggest three high-impact design changes to make it feel warmer, more elegant, and spacious without major renovations.

claude.p: I have uploaded a photo of my living room. Act as my interior stylist and suggest practical layout adjustments, lighting changes, and color palette ideas to elevate the space.

chatgpt.p: Act as my personal shopper. Search the web for a thoughtful gift for a friend who loves gardening, quiet coffee mornings, and classic design. My budget is 100 dollars. Give me five unique gift ideas, explain why each fits her style, and provide direct search terms or links to find them.

gemini.p: Act as my personal shopper. Find five distinct, high-quality gift ideas for someone who loves quiet mornings, gardening, and classic aesthetic. Keep the budget under 100 dollars and give me exact search terms.

claude.p: Act as my personal shopping advisor. Recommend five creative, elegant gift ideas under 100 dollars for a friend who appreciates gardening and relaxed living. Explain why each item is a great match.

chatgpt.p: Look at this photo of my family recipe card. Transcribe the text clearly, convert the measurements into standard metric units, and write out a clean, step-by-step recipe that I can print and save for my children.

gemini.p: Transcribe the handwritten text from this family document photo clearly. Format it into an organized, readable digital page that I can save.

claude.p: Transcribe the text in this uploaded family document image. Clean up any illegible words and format it into a beautiful, printable story or recipe.

chatgpt.p: I am reading about Renaissance architecture, but the terminology feels dense. Explain the three main differences between Gothic and Renaissance styles using simple analogies, as if we are walking through an art gallery together.

gemini.p: Explain Renaissance art history to me in plain, clear language. Focus on the main three concepts I should understand, using easy-to-remember real-world comparisons.

claude.p: Act as my personal cultural guide. Explain the key ideas behind Renaissance architecture in simple, engaging language without overly academic terms.

chatgpt.p: Act as my visual creative director. Help me build a visual concept for a fashion editorial portrait. Describe the lighting, high-fashion styling, color palette, and surreal mood in detail, then generate a visual concept.

gemini.p: Create a high-fashion editorial portrait concept featuring warm studio lighting, avant-garde styling, and a clean, elegant composition.

claude.p: Act as my creative director. Help me craft a detailed image prompt for Midjourney. I want a surreal, high-fashion portrait with sculptural chrome elements and cinematic studio lighting.

THREE.name: ChatGPT
THREE.title: CHATGPT: A WHOLE WORLD TO EXPLORE
paras: Music that matches your mood. An unusual treasure you didn’t know where to look for. Or a playful tarot-style reading, just for entertainment.
ChatGPT can suggest a tarot-style reading in conversation. For music and shopping, supported apps and search can take the idea further.
For example, a supported Spotify connection can help you discover music. Available apps and account requirements vary.

THREE.name: Gemini
THREE.title: GEMINI: BRING YOUR MEMORIES TO LIFE
paras: Decades of family photographs could become a beautiful story.
Start with old photographs, names, places and the details you remember.
With the photos and details you choose to share, Gemini can help draft a family timeline, captions and stories. Check names and dates yourself; it can’t know memories you haven’t supplied.
Explore a destination before ever visiting it, bringing together maps, places, travel information, and your own interests to discover things you might otherwise miss.
With supported Google services, Gemini can help connect different pieces of information to make the experience more personal.

THREE.name: Claude
THREE.title: CLAUDE: MAKE SOMETHING YOU THOUGHT YOU COULDN’T
paras: Your family’s treasured recipes could become a beautiful, interactive cookbook.
Not just a collection of recipes, but something you can open, explore, and share.
Or describe a little tool you’ve wished existed, perhaps for your wardrobe, your garden or your favorite places.
Claude’s artifacts can turn an ordinary description into a small interactive tool. The feature needs to be enabled, and the result still needs checking.
Something that began as an idea can become something you actually use.
